Print out a TMUX cheatsheet and a Lynx cheatsheet. Next, burn a livecd/liveusb. TMUX stands for terminal multiplexer, and it's a program to allow you to split your terminal into multiple terminals on 1 screen and on separate virtual workspaces. When you don't have an X server or window manager, TMUX is your bestest buddy for multitasking. Lynx is a command line web browser. This is pretty essential for googling how to get your desktop back!
